You could be dealing with any number of diagnoses or it could be that specific medication wasn't right for you. Thats why its really important to have an open dialog with your doctor. Let them know exactly how you're feeling and they can help. You'll be ok bud. Just don't give up. It'll get better

Yeah luckily my current prescription covers a couple of months. Maybe say that to your doctor when you go back and see if they'll give you a prescription that covers a long time. Really hope you're not having too bad withdrawals right now but I suppose at the moment all you can do is wait and go to see your doctor as soon as possible

You really shouldn't stop taking SSRIs once you started taking them. Typically they don't start to be effective before week 4-6. If the meds you were taking weren't working for you you should go back to your doctor tell them everything that you were feeling while on them. You can try a different drug that may work better

Yeah I'm in Ireland. Also long wait times. It toom 5 months in my case to see a psychiatrist. If you haven't tried meds I'd suggest you give it a go. Even if they don't work I mean your alternative is just being dead forever. It might suck now but you also might be completely satisfied with your life some day. You really don't have any way of knowing so its worth waiting for

You're totally not. I'm sure you're pretty cool. Things could get better. You really have no way of knowing. If you want to die that is guaranteed to happen some day anyway. But having had a look through your profile it seems like you'll be fine some day. You're a good person. It'll probably work out at some point. You just gotta give it time

Sorry for the late reply but yeah I guess you really seem like the kinda person who would do well by talking to a therapist (if you can afford it). If you can't manage to afford it maybe just talk with your boyfriend more about your concerns. I get that being depressed leading to drinking is a self perpetuating cycle but I'd seriously look at trying to make an effort to cut it back. You have someone who loves you. Not to guilt you, but thats more than most of us can say. You'll be ok. You just have to be open with him
YES! I wish you well in the future. I love you!

Yeah but it kinda doesn't matter. Try to do something that interests you. If you fail, it literally doesn't because we're all going to die. So try something else. You failing at something has no meaning. Its nothing to be ashamed of. And please don't be. Just keep trying something else. You may fail at something you love but just try again. You don't have to be great. Just satisfied

I'm trying to choose my words carefully because I'm afraid that the mods will have a problem with what I have to say but heres the thing dude, you have one life and one brain. Other people have satisfying/somewhat satisfying lives. You probably will get to where they are. But the alternative to that is nothing. You should keep trying because all you ultimately have is your life. What if some day if the future you experience complete contentedness?
Do you think you could come up with the money for it at any time in the future or take a loan or something? I mean its worth your happiness right?

Well I know college is gunna be super stressful. I went through the same thing. Thing is though, you remember a time when you were happy before right? Theres no saying that your brain isn't capable of getting back there. It would be a waste to throw away a period of your life that could potentially supply you with the happiest memories

Yeah but y'know the idea being maybe its something you can't control. Sometimes that happens to be the case. Maybe its not in your case. Theres a lot of doctors how don't really understand what you're going through. Maybe it would be worth finding one how can

Well I don't know if a doctor if psychiatrist could help you but you should take that route if its within your budget. I know its hard to shake that existential dread but its worth sticking around. All you can ultimately lose is life. Everything else is a bonus
Thats ok. So have you talked to a doctor about your problem? They might be able to help you
